.github/workflows/auto_pr_review.yaml.review: PR target-branch check; its job is gated to commaai/openpilot, so inert in Tandem.

.github/workflows/diff_report.yaml.review: pull_request_target: posts tests.yaml's result summary on Tandem's PRs (pull-requests:write). No branch, release or package writes.

.github/workflows/docs.yaml.review: Docs build on PRs and upstream branch pushes (contents:read); publishing and the self-hosted testing build are gated to commaai/openpilot or StarPilotHQ/StarPilot.

.github/workflows/flm-offroad.yaml.review: Read-only FLM tests on pushes to upstream's branch names (Dom, StarPilot, stable, testing, dev) and PRs into stable; Tandem has neither.

.github/workflows/galaxy-phone-bridge.ya.review: Read-only phone-bridge build check on pushes to upstream's branch names (not stable), and as a called workflow from tests.yaml.

.github/workflows/jenkins-pr-trigger.yam.review: Jenkins branch push and cleanup (contents:write). Tandem: both jobs gated to StarPilotHQ/StarPilot, inert here.

.github/workflows/pr_discord_reminder.ya.review: Discord PR reminder; gated to StarPilotHQ/StarPilot, inert in Tandem.

.github/workflows/release.yaml.review: Nightly release build; gated to commaai/openpilot, inert in Tandem.

.github/workflows/repo-maintenance.yaml.review: Dependency bump PRs and PR cleanup; gated to commaai/openpilot, inert in Tandem.

.github/workflows/safety.yaml.review: Read-only safety tests on PRs and upstream branch pushes (contents:read).

.github/workflows/stale.yaml.review: Daily stale-PR closer. Tandem: gated to StarPilotHQ/StarPilot, inert here.

.github/workflows/tandem_routing_maps.ya.review: Tandem's own monthly/manual routing-data build and publication (release's, with development's paths), pinned to the trigger commit. Read-only review job; contents:write only for the build and publish jobs, gated to jfgordon2/Tandem. valhalla pushes only review unless marked [routing-build-check]. Schedules run from the default branch, so this copy builds once this branch is release.

.github/workflows/tests.yaml.review: CI on PRs and upstream branch pushes, plus the phone-bridge check for PRs into stable; its artifact pushes are gated to commaai/openpilot master.

.github/workflows/ui_preview.yaml.review: UI screenshots for PRs against master only; Tandem has no master, so inert.
